wine-11.0/0001-winebus.patch: A USB pad's container comes from its location ID, so a game can pair it with its audio
wine-11.0/0002-winecoreaudio.patch: The pad's audio endpoints answer DEVPKEY_Device_ContainerId with the pad's container
wine-11.0/0003-mmdevapi.patch: An active endpoint's container is asked of the driver, not read from the registry
wine-11.17/0001-winebus.patch: A USB pad's container comes from its location ID, so a game can pair it with its audio
wine-11.17/0002-winecoreaudio.patch: The pad's audio endpoints answer DEVPKEY_Device_ContainerId with the pad's container
wine-11.17/0003-mmdevapi.patch: An active endpoint's container is asked of the driver, not read from the registry
wine-11.17/0004-winebus-bluetooth.patch: A Bluetooth DualSense or Edge is shown to the game as the same pad on a cable
A Bluetooth pad gets the audio output its wired self would have, for its haptics
wine-11.17/0006-winebus-xinput-and-trigg: XInput's rumble on the pad's motors, trigger effects chosen in Game Feel, a steadier Bluetooth stream
wine-11.17/0007-hidclass-xinput.patch: A pad with a haptics collection is also offered to XInput
wine-11.17/0008-xinput-sony-order.patch: XInput reads a Sony pad's own descriptor in Sony's order
wine-11.17/0009-mmdevapi-setupapi-endpoi: Audio endpoints are listed through SetupAPI as Windows lists them, with the pad's container
wine-11.17/0010-setupapi-base-containeri: SetupDiGetDeviceRegistryPropertyA returns SPDRP_BASE_CONTAINERID as a WCHAR string, as Windows does
wine-11.17/0011-xaudio2-mastering-voice-: An XAudio2 mastering voice opens the device the game names, not the default one
wine-11.17/0012-winecoreaudio-edge-outpu: An Edge shown as a DualSense has the DualSense's audio device on a cable too
wine-11.17/0013-winebus-dualshock4.patch: The pad shown to a game as a USB DualShock 4 (pad_as=dualshock4)
wine-11.17/0014-winebus-trigger-replace-: A chosen trigger effect can replace the game's own, and Game Feel's changes reach a running game
wine-11.17/0015-winebus-input-rate-once-: With diagnostics on, the pad's input rate is logged once a minute, not every 2 s
